vertical_slice_art_policy.rule: Golden Loop world surfaces House -> Chapter Route -> Level Pre-start -> Gameplay -> Win/Rewards -> House Restoration -> House -> Curio verification use authored raster environment art where the screen contract owns a background slot; SVG/procedural world illustration is forbidden.
vertical_slice_art_policy.note: Authored raster reference-slice candidates are wired into Godot with no SVG world-art fallback. Current repo copies are transport previews; they are not final-resolution approval assets.

production_gate.rule: Only authored-art slots owned by the canonical screen/state contract may enter production. No downstream bulk art before Golden Loop acceptance.
